results.title: Ryan Ray chosen to serve as interim Madison County sheriff after previous officeholder announced resignation
results.description: The Madison County Quorum Court unanimously appointed Ryan Ray as interim sheriff Monday, filling a role that was set to be left vacant by Ronnie Boyd's resignation that was announced late last month.

results.title: National Night Out brings Philadelphia communities, police together
results.description: Philadelphia hosted 21 National Night Out events Tuesday as residents and police gathered to build trust and strengthen community relationships.
